name: Scattering Sample
description: A surface sample for the virtual scattering lab: a relief mesh, a Brep, a surface or a SubD, as drawn or as a tile repeated over a disc, with the flat reference it is measured against. Meters.

inputParameters.name: geometry
inputParameters.description: The relief: a mesh, Brep, surface or SubD. In disc mode, the tile to repeat.

inputParameters.name: mode
inputParameters.description: 'as_drawn' measures the geometry as drawn; 'disc' repeats it as a tile over a disc of the given diameter.

inputParameters.name: diameter
inputParameters.description: Disc mode only, and required there: the diameter of the disc in m.

inputParameters.name: reference
inputParameters.description: Optional. As-drawn mode only: a mesh, Brep, surface or SubD to take as the reference instead of the flat footprint of the relief.

inputParameters.name: baseplate
inputParameters.description: Thickness of the plate below the relief, in m.

inputParameters.name: symmetry
inputParameters.description: 'none' or 'rotational' (the sample repeats under rotation about its centre).
